decisions.statement: A scan stating no capture moment is timed from the moment the import runs.
A capture moment the scan states is read as whole seconds.
The reading is filed on the hour page for the moment the scan was captured.
Only the locations the account owns count toward net worth.
An unmanaged guild bank is reported by name with the gold set aside with that bank.
A new exclusion reason is a compile error rather than an unlabelled row.
The report is returned as lines rather than written where the report is computed.
Everything a run reaches outside itself is given to that run as an argument.
A filing refused ends the import rather than being reported.
A scan is written onto the account page as well as counted toward net worth.

definition: one inventory scan read, valued, and filed as a net worth reading on its hour page
